mapper.sql: id, user_id, checkin_date, fortune_level, fortune_stars, lucky_color, lucky_color_hex, lucky_number, `suit`, `avoid`, fortune_text, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `checkin` (user_id, checkin_date, fortune_level, fortune_stars, lucky_color, lucky_color_hex, lucky_number, `suit`, `avoid`, fortune_text) VALUES (#{userId}, #{checkinDate}, #{fortuneLevel}, #{fortuneStars}, #{luckyColor}, #{luckyColorHex}, #{luckyNumber}, #{suit}, #{avoid}, #{fortuneText})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `checkin` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND checkin_date = #{date}
SELECT checkin_date FROM `checkin` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY checkin_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT checkin_date FROM `checkin` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND checkin_date >= #{from} AND checkin_date < #{to} ORDER BY checkin_date
